description: This file defines the interface for GLClosure write operations within the accounting closure service of the Fineract project. It declares methods for creating, updating, and deleting general ledger closure records.

classes.name: GLClosureWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface that defines methods for creating, updating, and deleting GL closure records in the accounting system.

methods.name: createGLClosure
methods.description: Creates a new GL closure record based on the provided command.

methods.name: updateGLClosure
methods.description: Updates an existing GL closure identified by glClosureId with the data provided in the command.

methods.name: deleteGLClosure
methods.description: Deletes the GL closure record identified by glClosureId.
